## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/anthropic/common_utils.py

Prompts

```
['build Anthropic API request headers with OAuth, beta features, and tool detection support', 'validate Anthropic API credentials and auto-detect OAuth tokens in request headers', 'strip advisor server_tool_use blocks from Anthropic assistant message content', 'strip thinking and redacted_thinking blocks from Anthropic messages to recover from invalid signatures', 'process Anthropic rate-limit and response headers into OpenAI-compatible format', 'calculate the prompt and completion cost in USD for an Anthropic model given usage with caching details', 'compute only the cache read and cache write cost portion of an Anthropic prompt cost', 'get the total cost of web search tool requests for an Anthropic model call']
```

Usage

```
{'build_anthropic_request_headers': 'build Anthropic API request headers with OAuth, beta features, and tool detection support', 'validate_anthropic_credentials': 'validate Anthropic API credentials and auto-detect OAuth tokens in request headers', 'strip_advisor_blocks_from_messages': 'strip advisor server_tool_use blocks from Anthropic assistant message content', 'strip_thinking_blocks_from_anthropic_messages': 'strip thinking and redacted_thinking blocks from Anthropic messages to recover from invalid signatures', 'process_anthropic_headers': 'process Anthropic rate-limit and response headers into OpenAI-compatible format'}
```

Prompts

